newsitem.title: NORWAY: Lackluster Norway shares steady, quiet time ahead.
newsitem.headline: Lackluster Norway shares steady, quiet time ahead.

text.p: Norwegian stocks lacked impetus on Wednesday and moved in a narrow band in dull trade. Dealers said that in the absence of any fresh news the market was likely to remain flat for the forthcoming summer period.

"Unless there is news I don't think the market will do much for the next few weeks. The summer is almost here and a lot of investors seem to have covered themselves by selling the small caps and buying into the blue chips," said one dealer.
He said some of the oil stocks might suffer from the drop in oil prices, which have fallen six percent in 10 days and technology stocks continued to lag.

Oslo's Total share index retreated 0.14 percent to close the session at 1,177.13 points having moved in a range between 1,174.77 points and 1,181.46 points. Turnover was a moderate 764 million crowns.
Norwegian Cruise Liners was the most traded stock in turnover terms at almosy 100 million crowns and closed 0.40 crowns up at 22.20 crowns.
Dealers attributed the rise to several positive analysts' recommendations.
